channel.title: Whittier Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Whittier Daily News (whittierdailynews.com)

item.title: Kings let late lead slip away in loss to Canadiens
item.description: Alex Laferriere’s go-ahead goal in the third doesn’t hold up as the Kings fall 4-3 to Montreal.

item.title: Khalil Mack reportedly agrees to 1-year, $18 million deal with Chargers
item.description: The 35-year-old had 5½ sacks last season for the 11-6 Chargers.

item.title: Dodgers let early lead slip away in loss to Rockies
item.description: Blake Treinen struggles with his command, and the Dodgers waste RBI hits from Andy Pages, Alex Call and Teoscar Hernandez in a 6-4 loss to Colorado on Saturday at Camelback Ranch.

item.title: UCLA men pick up 2nd win over USC to finish Big Ten regular season
item.description: Donovan Dent leads an 89-68 rout at Galen Center with 25 points and seven assists. USC drops its seventh straight despite 20 points from Alijah Arenas as both teams head to next week’s Big Ten Tournament in Chicago.

item.title: Bishop Amat’s playoff win streak ends with loss to Los Alamitos in regional final
item.description: Bishop Amat's boys soccer team had won 15 consecutive playoff games but Los Alamitos ends the streak in the CIF SoCal Division III Regional title game.

item.title: Clippers storm back to edge Grizzlies
item.description: The Clippers trail by 19 in the first half before rallying behind Darius Garland’s 11 fourth-quarter points for a 123-120 win over the Grizzlies. Kawhi Leonard finishes with 28 points, and Bennedict Mathurin adds 21.

item.title: Cal State Fullerton men stun CSUN late, grab No. 3 seed for Big West tourney
item.description: The Titans make 18 3-pointers and close the game on a 15-0 run for a 90-77 road win in their regular-season finale, improving their tournament seeding thanks to a pair of late-season sweeps.

item.title: Galaxy fade late in loss to Rapids
item.description: João Klauss scores in the 56th minute, but the Galaxy finish with 10 men and concede three goals after halftime in a 4-1 loss.

item.title: Damien rallies to beat Crean Lutheran and advances to CIF regional finals
item.description: Damien's basketball team trails by 15 points in the third quarter, but then dominates the rest of the way to advance to the Division I final in the CIF Southern California Regional playoffs.

item.title: David Martínez lifts LAFC past Dallas
item.description: Martínez scores the game’s lone goal, and Hugo Lloris helps LAFC open the season with a third straight shutout victory.
